name: Fried shrimp cake
summary: Fried shrimp cake is named on Can Tho’s food list. It is a different snack from bánh cống, the mung-bean and taro fritter topped with a whole shrimp.
howToEat: Order it with the city’s other plates. Bánh cống is the separate fritter.
